evals.prompt: I want a chart of my data but I'm not sure what kind.
evals.expected_output: Asks for data location (path/csv/df) and relevant columns before coding; may suggest 2-3 chart options and wait for user choice

evals.prompt: Help me create a scatter plot from my DataFrame with columns such as x,y coordinates from tsne or umap or PCA, and labx. Color points by labx.
evals.expected_output: Data and chart already specified — uses d3.scatter with x= and y= arrays (not d3.scatter(df)); color from labx; runnable code

evals.prompt: I have a CSV with columns A, B, and C that might be flows between things.
evals.expected_output: Asks which columns are source/target/weight (or confirms mapping); suggests chord and/or sankey; waits for user to choose before full implementation

evals.prompt: I have source, target, and weight columns for energy flows between categories. What chart and code should I use?
evals.expected_output: Suggests chord (and optionally sankey); user can confirm; example with import_example('energy') or user's df; d3.chord(df)

evals.prompt: Draw a process flowchart: Start -> Valid? (decision) -> Done or Fix then back to Valid?. Prefer a layered diagram.
evals.expected_output: Recommend flowgraph; edge list with shapes or Mermaid; direction TB; runnable code

evals.prompt: Embed a D3Blocks chord chart in Streamlit with side panel toggles.
evals.expected_output: showfig=False, return_html=True, color_background='streamlit', st.iframe; sidebar checkboxes for show_side_panel/show_top_panel

evals.prompt: I have an energy flow network with source, target, weight. I want to explore connections around the Solar node.
evals.expected_output: Suggest radialgraph with center='Solar' (and optionally d3graph); after user confirms, runnable d3.radialgraph code

evals.prompt: I have energy flows with source, target, weight and want a left-to-right stage diagram, not a circle.
evals.expected_output: Suggest sankey (vs chord); after confirm, d3.sankey with node/link options; runnable code

evals.prompt: I have logs with datetime, user_id, and activity labels and want to see how people move between activities over a day.
evals.expected_output: Suggest movingbubbles; map columns to datetime/sample_id/state; after confirm, d3.movingbubbles runnable code

evals.prompt: Compare age distributions across cancer types in my data (labx and age columns).
evals.expected_output: Suggest violin with x=labx y=age; never d3.violin(df); runnable code after confirm

evals.prompt: Show hierarchical energy categories as nested rectangles sized by weight.
evals.expected_output: Suggest treemap (vs tree); source/target/weight; value size/count; runnable code

evals.prompt: Draw a hierarchical tree of energy flows (source/target), not a treemap.
evals.expected_output: Suggest tree; hierarchy/link_length; runnable d3.tree code

evals.prompt: Cluster and color an adjacency matrix of character interactions.
evals.expected_output: Suggest heatmap; stormofswords or matrix df; cluster_params optional; runnable code

evals.prompt: Plot lon/lat surf spots on a world map.
evals.expected_output: Suggest maps with import_example('surfspots') or lon/lat columns; runnable d3.maps

evals.prompt: Plot climate variables over dates from a table with a date column.
evals.expected_output: Suggest timeseries with datetime= and dt_format; not movingbubbles; runnable code

evals.prompt: Show a force network with Louvain clusters as hulls on energy flows.
evals.expected_output: Suggest elasticgraph; source/target/weight; runnable code

evals.prompt: Draw a free force-directed graph of energy source/target/weight edges.
evals.expected_output: Suggest d3graph (not radialgraph unless focus needed); runnable code

evals.prompt: Show hierarchy as nested circles sized by edge weight.
evals.expected_output: Suggest circlepacking (vs treemap); size sum/constant; runnable code

evals.prompt: Make the word D3Blocks out of interactive particles.
evals.expected_output: Suggest particles with text string; runnable d3.particles

evals.prompt: Compare two telescope images with a before/after slider.
evals.expected_output: Suggest imageslider; import_example southern_nebula; runnable code

evals.prompt: Draw a sequence diagram of Alice and Bob messages.
evals.expected_output: Suggest sequence; message columns or Mermaid; confirm API with pydoc

evals.prompt: Show Customer-Order-LineItem as an ER diagram.
evals.expected_output: Suggest erd; cardinalities or Mermaid erDiagram

evals.prompt: Colour a numeric table as a simple matrix (not full heatmap clustering).
evals.expected_output: Suggest matrix vs heatmap; runnable d3.matrix
